_doc: The RIVER, as declared data. Not a film: there is no duration and no end. This declares a PHRASE — an order of movements and how the camera behaves through them — and the engine traverses it forever. Each traversal is a PASSAGE with its own seed, its own material and its own durations, and a passage that has gone by does not come back. Movements declare a `share` of the passage, normalised to fit, so the no-gaps/no-overlaps partition the 2017 score obeys over the frame is true here over time BY CONSTRUCTION. `vary` is why it is a river and not a loop: a fixed phrase length is a clock, and a viewer who can anchor to it is watching a loop with the fill changed.
title: THE THING WITHOUT A NAME
author: Anthony J. Padavano

passage._doc: The nominal phrase, and how far each passage may stray from it. Never rendered as a fixed length.

signature._doc: The last seconds of every passage. White on black, one line: the seed of the passage that just went by. It is the receipt — proof that what was seen existed once and will not recur.

captures._doc: Presets for RECORDING the river — never for defining it. A capture has a length and a format; where it starts is a choice made at capture time, and what it caught is named by the passage seed. Frame rates are held to submission/screendance-2027.yaml's `fps_allowed` by check-danse.py.

passage.note: One whole passage at 4K — the ScreenDance Miami submission, honest about being one of them

midnight-moment.note: Times Square Arts — EXACTLY 170s horizontal, rolling

reel.note: 15s vertical, one continuous move, loop-safe, silent-legible

movements.title: one photograph, whole
movements.note: An unaltered 2017 photograph, untreated, barely moving. Provenance first: before the machine does anything, the viewer sees what was actually photographed. Room and floor line established here and never contradicted.

movements.title: the 2017 composite
movements.note: The photograph divides into the hand-cut composite he made in 2017, and holds it flat. This is the actual artifact on screen — verify.html proves it renders at 31.60 dB against the original. The credibility floor of the whole piece: the concept predates the technology by nine years.

movements.title: the composite comes apart
movements.note: What flies apart is literally the 2017 composite, not a generated approximation of it. The camera leaves the projector's eye — that alone un-flattens the picture, which is the probe's third result. They learn the space is impossible while the floor line still holds.

movements.title: the engine, countable
movements.note: Full engine. Limbs arrive from different photographs on a pulse. Must have accents, a repeat and a variation so a dance-literate viewer can COUNT it. Do not let this become texture — texture is the failure mode of the whole form.

movements.title: a body that never existed
movements.note: Resolves to near-stasis. One near-complete figure assembles out of many photographs and holds — a body that never existed, in a room that never existed. Hold it longer than is comfortable.

movements.title: again, and again, faster
movements.note: The engine visibly restarts — same structural moves, entirely different material — then again, faster, then again. The gaps shorten: 0.42, 0.29, 0.17, 0.09. THE INFINITUDE IS DELIVERED BY THAT COMPRESSION, NOT ASSERTED. Cut to black mid-phrase.

movements.title: the only name it has
movements.note: Four seconds. One line of white text: the seed of the version they just watched. The thing they watched has no name — only a number — which is the title, restated as a fact.
